question: Did Q-Neuro Nova discover a genuinely better way for neural networks to compute?
verdict: NO - NO NEW SUPERIOR ARCHITECTURE SURVIVED
ladder_position: NOVA-1 (Anomaly): interesting repeatable behaviour, no capability edge that is not prior art

mechanism_families: attention normalisation (softmax, log-length temperature, max, threshold)
disjoint-parameter modularity with gated late fusion
linear attention, retention, diagonal and selective state-space models
gated RNNs, transformers with three position schemes, causal MLP

why_no: The two leading architectures are prior-art compositions. rnn_attn_max is an attention-augmented RNN (Bahdanau 2014); cursor reproduces NTM location addressing (Graves 2014), more weakly than the original, on the task the NTM paper introduced it for.
All three frozen hypotheses were falsified: H-DILUTION by its own confound control, H-INTERFERENCE on all four clauses, H-COMPOSE on two of three.
No capability leap. The best mean is 0.692 against the strongest baseline's 0.574, and the gain comes from adding two known mechanisms to an LSTM.
Two capabilities remain unsolved by everything: copy (best 0.470) and reverse (best 0.371), against a chance level of 0.126.
what_survives: A capability matrix over 32 architectures on five shortcut-audited tasks at four times the trained length, with matched parameters, matched training budget and three seeds.
A shortcut audit that disqualified two of the programme's own tasks before any candidate was compared (position-only scores 0.887 on cummax and 0.598 on sort at length 64).
An operator-level length-invariance probe that separates 'the operator has the property' from 'the property helps' -- which turned out to be different questions.

One negative characterisation: capability competition is conserved. Adding a third route relieved the state-tracking/retrieval conflict (mod_sum 0.776 to 0.998 with needle at 0.977) and simultaneously destroyed ordered memory (reverse 0.348 to 0.146). The conflict moved rather than resolving.
validity_threat_found_and_corrected: The initial 800-step budget was undertrained and inflated the apparent interference: the hybrid's mod_sum reads 0.291 at 800 steps and 0.776 at 2400. Every headline number was re-measured at 2400 steps. The H-INTERFERENCE result stands as scored, but its narrative was corrected.
termination_justification: Six distinct mechanism families explored; the last three rounds all produced prior-art compositions.
No candidate retains a capability signal that survives the prior-art firewall.

The remaining directive branches (complex fields, sub-agents, homeostasis, self-repair, development, distillation) were either already falsified in an earlier era or are lower-value given what the frontier shows.
Further local search would be tiny mutations of compositions that are already known.
